rulings.restated: Add person.se_line6 over every confirmed person entry, within the current person when parent-bound. An unanswered roster is unknown.
rulings.model: The form says "Self-employment income from Schedule SE (Form 1040), Part I, line 6. If you had a loss, enter -0-", and the instructions say negative amounts shouldn't be considered. The restatement sums person.se_line6 with no per-person floor at zero, and the text given does not show whether se_line6 is already nonnegative, so a loss on one spouse's Schedule SE could offset the other's income.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; restatement accepted. person.se_line6 is a non-negative line (Schedule SE line 6 is zero when line 4c is less than $400, and lines 4a and 4c are zero or more for a profit; a loss enters zero), so a loss on one spouse's Schedule SE enters zero and cannot offset the other's; the sum is the per-person line 6 with negative amounts not considered, as the instructions say.
